name: Curtin University
summary: Perth university with four faculties; a full IB Diploma of 24 points opens most degrees and Engineering asks 31, with Semester 1 and 2 starts.

ib.text: A full IB Diploma of at least 24 points covers most degrees; indicative totals rise to 31 for Engineering and Pharmacy, 35 for Law and Physiotherapy, 36 for Actuarial Science and 39 for Medicine, plus prerequisites.

apply.via: Direct to Curtin (online portal or agent)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
programmes.about: Four years that start with a shared Engineering Foundation Year, then a major such as Chemical, Civil and Construction, Electrical and Electronic, Mechanical, Mechatronic or Mining Engineering.
programmes.ib: The IB page gives an indicative 31 points; this course page shows a cut-off of 30. Take 31 as the safe figure and check prerequisites.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB total against the course's cut-off; the course page lists a guaranteed ATAR of 80 and an IB score of 30.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours): a shared Engineering Foundation Year and a wide choice of engineering majors

faculties.name: Faculty of Science and Engineering
faculties.line: Engineering (Honours) asks an indicative IB 31; Science (Science) and Agribusiness start at 24.

faculties.name: Faculty of Business and Law
faculties.line: Commerce and Business Administration start at IB 24; Laws asks 35 and Actuarial Science 36.

faculties.name: Faculty of Health Sciences
faculties.line: Nursing and Health Sciences start at IB 24; Pharmacy 31, Physiotherapy 35, Medicine 39.

faculties.name: Faculty of Humanities
faculties.line: Arts, Social Work, Psychology and Education degrees start at IB 24.

notes: Curtin lists every program on its IB page with an indicative IB total, and the totals are subject to change.
International applications close four weeks before the course starts for most countries and ten weeks before for some, and quota courses such as Medicine have their own dates.
Curtin Singapore is a separate campus with its own record.
